name: Codex Agent Tool Workflow
intent: Hand off a specific tool to Codex for local enhancement, hardening, or production-readiness work.
scope: Work only inside the selected local_null_ai_* folder.
Do not modify original non-prefixed folders.

steps.title: Inspect the tool
steps.prompt: Read the TOOL.md, manifest.json, package.json (if any), and entrypoint files. List the runtimes and key files.

steps.title: Add agent surface
steps.prompt: Ensure the tool has a predictable local entrypoint, documented commands, and output folders. Add a CLI wrapper if missing.

steps.title: Harden for local use
steps.prompt: Fix placeholders, add error handling, ensure it runs without network if possible. Add safety notes.

steps.title: Verify
steps.prompt: Run the smallest available validation. If dependencies are blocked, state exactly what could not run.
